assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All area, ratio, key-area and mobility conclusions use provisional geometry and must be recomputed after official polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines and municipal data are supplied.
assumptions.impact: The concept can be reviewed for ideas and structure but not used as a statutory plan, engineering basis or government commitment.

assumptions.statement: All newly added figures, PDFs, HTML, matrices, and brand-symbol directions are generated assets documented in report/asset_license_inventory.json; no remote assets or third-party marks are embedded.
assumptions.impact: Public brand rollout still requires separately cleared font, trademark, and contributor-name permissions.

assumptions.statement: Implementation matrix KPIs are operational recommendations, not approved government targets or funded commitments.
assumptions.impact: Professional teams must validate owner, budget, approval path, public engagement, and exit conditions before implementation.
